summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: This package impersonates the Ornikar ESLint config scope but its behavior is inconsistent with an ESLint config. Its package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style mangled (identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, and property-lookup objects `YCZJE`/`QkQej`/`JBhWy` hiding strings like `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, `musl`) and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes the freshly downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line bundle heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (shift-based decoder `WV8StW`, hex-style variable names, `// @bun @bun-cjs` marker) whose behavior is not inspectable in source form. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate need for a JavaScript alternate runtime nor for a large obfuscated blob executed at install time. This matches the npm alternate-runtime dropper pattern: fetch a non-Node runtime, then execute attacker-shipped obfuscated code under that runtime to evade Node-only scanners. The payload runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
